results.title: Eyes on the Text: Assessing Readability of Artificial Intelligence and Ophthalmologist Responses to Patient Surgery Queries.
results.abstract: Readability of GPT-4 and ophthalmologist responses was assessed using six validated metrics: Flesch Kincaid Reading Ease (FK-RE), Flesch Kincaid Grade Level (FK-GL), Gunning Fog Score (GFS), SMOG Index (SI), Coleman Liau Index (CLI), and Automated Readability Index (ARI).
